findings.message: 1 line in "Tyre blew out: now you've stopped" has no quote from the guideline ("What to do if it happens again while driving (read this l…"). Fine for app wording; an instruction should quote its source.
1 line in "Wait safely for help" has no quote from the guideline ("Wait safely for help to arrive."). Fine for app wording; an instruction should quote its source.
1 line in "Swap the wheel" has no quote from the guideline ("This order is from Drive; the sources don't give an order…"). Fine for app wording; an instruction should quote its source.
1 line in "Get the flat tyre fixed" has no quote from the guideline ("Tyre changed. Get the flat one repaired or replaced soon."). Fine for app wording; an instruction should quote its source.
The guideline mentions 1 amount the template never uses: 2 minute. Some may be background; check none were left out.
Nobody is named under "Reviewed by:", so the app shows "Not reviewed".
The saved guideline text is a web copy made by a fetch tool and may not be word-perfect, so a "quote not found" may be the copy's fault. Add the PDF to sources/ for exact checking.
